note: Spectrum's online prices are introductory and usually last 12 months. After that, the regular rate applies, so long-time customers often pay much more than new ones.
Xfinity has offered new customers multi-year price guarantees, but customers on older plans often pay far more than the current new-customer price for the same speed.
AT&T simplified its fiber lineup in June 2026. Fiber plans have symmetrical upload and download speeds, and bundling with AT&T wireless lowers the price.
Google Fiber (GFiber) says it has no promotional prices or annual rate hikes, so the advertised price is the price you keep.
T-Mobile 5G Home Internet runs on its cellular network, so speeds depend on signal and tower congestion. Prices drop if you also have a T-Mobile phone line.
T-Mobile Fiber is available in a limited number of areas and has advertised long price guarantees.
Verizon Fios prices include a multi-year price guarantee on eligible plans and are lower if you also have a Verizon phone plan.
Verizon 5G Home Internet uses Verizon's 5G network. Prices drop with an eligible Verizon mobile plan.
